question: Name the only Indian athlete who received the Padma Bhushan Award for the year 2022
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia **is an **Indian Paralympic javelin thrower **competing in **F46 events**.
 
• He is the **first Indian Paralympics player **to **win two gold medals **at the **Paralympics**.
 
• He was born on **10 June 1981 **(age 41 years) in **Churu**.
 
• He was **awarded Padma Bhushan**, **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award **for **Para-Athletics**, **Padma Shri**, **Arjuna Award **for **Athletics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vandana Katariya **is an **Indian field hockey player**. She plays as a forward in the Indian national team. **Vandana rose **to **prominence **in **2013**, being **India's top goal-scorer **in the **2013 Women's Hockey Junior World Cup**, where **India won a bronze medal**; she **scored five goals **in the **tournament**, the **third by any player**.
 
• **Faisal Ali Dar **is an **Indian sports enthusiast**, and the **first person **to **receive the Padma Shri Award **in **sports from **Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• **Sankara Narayana Menon Chundayil **popularly known as **Unni Gurukkal **is **a Kalaripayattu gurukkal **or teacher from **Chavakkad**. For his contributions in the field of Kalaripayattu, he has **won several noted awards **including **Kerala Folklore Academy Award **and **India's forth highest civilian honor Padma Shri.**
